dread.basis: Michael watched at the edge of frame all day while friends dismiss Laurie; the stalking occupies the film, killings are brief

cruelty.basis: Bob pinned to a wall, Lynda strangled by phone cord while Laurie listens; harm is deliberate and posed for effect

irony.basis: 'You can't kill the boogeyman' is played straight and the ending confirms it — no gap between image and intent

ambiguity.basis: Six shots, a fall, and the body is gone; Loomis is unsurprised — what Michael is stays unanswered

fracture.basis: A dated 1963 prologue, then straight through Oct 30–31 1978 with no further displacement

dread.basis: Illegal pig slaughter carries the death penalty and the exposure lands late; most scenes are shopping and flirting

cruelty.basis: The women stage a fake rape to send Fred to the Eastern Front, where he is killed — reported in one line

irony.basis: Extorted Jewish money funds a girls' sightseeing trip; the war ends as a street greeting after a windshield-smashing quarrel

ambiguity.basis: Every thread closes: swindler robbed back, aunt dead, Fred killed, women reconciled on V-E Day

fracture.basis: Single forward line, then two announced year-jumps to 1944 and V-E Day as an epilogue

born on the fourth of july.wikipedia: Born on the Fourth of July (film)

dread.basis: Harm arrives and is then lived with — the wound, the hospital, the wheelchair; little time is spent anticipating

cruelty.basis: Villagers shot by mistake, a crying baby abandoned, orderlies ignoring patients, the widow refusing forgiveness

irony.basis: The Fourth of July parade returns as the site of his breakdown, but the film plainly endorses Kovic's speeches

ambiguity.basis: Dated march 1956→1976 ending on a podium; guilt confessed, politics stated, nothing withheld

fracture.basis: Strict chronology by year, broken once by a flashback the crying baby triggers

dread.basis: The frame opens at her statue after her death, so the rebellion and the stated death penalty for consorts are foregone

cruelty.basis: She is hanged and her sisters killed, but the film's disposition is elegiac; the emperor is pitied, not punished

irony.basis: A lute song, a resemblance to the dead empress, reunion in death — the romance is offered without defence

ambiguity.basis: Motives are stated outright (Lushan's, the family's, hers) and the frame closes on his death

fracture.basis: The whole story sits inside one reminiscence, opening and closing at the statue

dread.basis: The corpse fails to surface, the suit returns from the cleaners, the school photo shows him — waiting is the whole second half

cruelty.basis: The entire plot is a scheme to frighten a woman with a known heart condition to death, and it is carried out

irony.basis: The reveal retroactively makes every earlier scene a performance staged for Christina's benefit

ambiguity.basis: The plot is fully explained, then the boy says Christina gave him the slingshot — one fact left permanently open

fracture.basis: Strict forward order; the withheld information is concealment, not displacement

dread.basis: A self-destruct pod and AUTO's mutiny are brief; most time is salvage, courtship and dancing in space

cruelty.basis: AUTO electrocutes and crushes WALL-E and wipes his memory, but the wipe is undone by a kiss

irony.basis: Consumerism satire (Buy n Large, immobile passengers) sits against a love story the film plays wholly straight

ambiguity.basis: Directive exposed, ship returned, robot restored, plant grown into a tree — every question answered on screen

fracture.basis: 700-year backstory delivered as prologue, then one continuous forward line

dread.basis: A dying chairman and Havelka's burning house exist, but the evening's engine is embarrassment, not anticipated harm

cruelty.basis: A father buys drinks to enter his homely daughter, contestants flee to the toilets, an old woman is crowned as a joke

irony.basis: The ceremonial gift box is opened empty; charity tickets are redeemed for prizes the donors themselves stole

ambiguity.basis: The thefts are never pinned on anyone, and the closing image of Havelka in bed by the ruins is left unglossed

fracture.basis: One evening in order, then the next morning; no displacement at all

dread.basis: Mother's deadline runs under everything — pay $300 or be hospitalised — alongside withdrawal and the father's imminent discovery

cruelty.basis: The father systematically belittles Polo; Johnny coerces him by threatening to throw himself into traffic

irony.basis: The war-hero-turned-addict is stated flatly and the confessions are meant; nothing is held at a distance

ambiguity.basis: Debt paid, habit confessed to wife and father, police called — every concealment is opened before the end

fracture.basis: Continuous over roughly two days, with the war and hospital given only as spoken background

dread.basis: Deployed and armed for months with no enemy; the harm expected all film (the shot, the contact) never arrives

cruelty.basis: Comrades brand Troy with a red-hot iron; the squad walks the Highway of Death past charred bodies

irony.basis: A trained sniper's one shot is cancelled by an airstrike, and he says aloud that his elite skill is meaningless

ambiguity.basis: A closing roll-call fixes what became of each Marine, including Troy's death and the girlfriend's infidelity

fracture.basis: Linear 1989→war→homecoming, with a montage of characters' later lives jumping years ahead

dread.basis: Violence detonates without warning — a shooting in a café, a stranger stabbing himself, a self-immolation — but never accumulates

cruelty.basis: A man borrows Paul's matches to burn himself alive; Paul's fall from a window is disposed of in a police statement

irony.basis: The summary's own 'Godard, through Robert, constructs the idea of worker as revolutionary' — speech is quotation, polling is the subject

ambiguity.basis: Accident or suicide is asserted, not shown; the pregnancy is doubted by Elisabeth and Madeleine ends unsure what she will do

fracture.basis: Episodic scenes with dated blocks, and the death reaches us only as testimony recounted at a police station
